The '''''Temerit''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]].<ref name="AJ3">{{JournalCite|3|Droid Trouble}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] escorted a [[Prison ship/Legends|dungeon ship]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] for the [[Subjugation of Lktim|subjugation of the city of]] [[Lktim]].<ref name="AJ3" />
